summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone attack on October 10-11 involving approximately 160 drones, including 110 attack drones, with Shaheds striking Kyiv's Nivky, Akadem, Berkovets districts and the Lavina shopping mall while Geran-5 rockets targeted multiple northern and central Ukrainian regions. The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed territorial gains in Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia oblasts during October 3-9. The United States threatened to halt weapons supplies to Ukraine over strikes on Russian oil refineries, with Trump reportedly demanding Kyiv cease such attacks and suggesting a leadership change.
key_points: Russia launched ~160 drones overnight Oct 10, including 110 attack drones, with Shaheds hitting Kyiv districts and Geran-5 rockets targeting multiple regions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
Ukrainian air defense reported jet Shaheds falling on Kyiv's Nivky, Akadem, Berkovets areas and Lavina shopping mall. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76630, @mon1tor_ua/76631)
Russian MoD claimed capture of Annopol, Nova Kazachya (Kharkiv), Kiyanitsa (Sumy), Samoylovka, Golubkovo (Zaporizhzhia) during Oct 3-9. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
US threatened to stop weapons supplies to Ukraine over refinery strikes; Trump reportedly 'very angry' and demands attacks cease. (Source: @UkraineNow/84604)
Zelensky conditioned elections on 60-day Russian ceasefire, responding to Trump's pressure for leadership change. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33890)
Geran-5 rockets and jet Shaheds tracked from Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Bryansk toward Kyiv, Rivne, Volyn, Dnipropetrovsk, Cherkasy, Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76666, @mon1tor_ua/76664)
Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure Oct 7-10 caused emergency shutdowns in Kyiv, disrupting metro, water, and industry; Ukrenergo introduced schedules. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
Estonia's PM Michal urged EU to accelerate aid for Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries after Trump eased diesel restrictions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33886)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted its largest drone wave of the war overnight October 10-11, launching approximately 160 drones including 110 attack drones that struck Kyiv's western districts and the Lavina mall while Geran-5 rockets proliferated across northern Ukraine. Simultaneously, the Russian Ministry of Defense announced the capture of five settlements in Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia oblasts, signaling continued ground offensive momentum. The United States escalated diplomatic pressure by threatening to suspend military aid over Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, with Trump explicitly demanding a halt to energy infrastructure attacks and floating a leadership change in Kyiv.

points: Ukrainian forces struck a petroleum transshipment terminal in Rostov-on-Don on October 10, connected to the Novoshakhtinsk oil products plant, injuring six people and damaging residential buildings, a railway bridge, and two ships in the Azov Sea. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

President Zelensky declared Ukraine will hold elections only if Russia observes a 60-day complete ceasefire, stating the decision belongs solely to the Ukrainian people and requires secure voting infrastructure. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33890)

Zelensky responded to Trump's ceasefire proposals by saying Ukraine is ready to accept a cessation of hostilities if Trump and Putin have agreed on one, urging communication of the start date. (Source: @UkraineNow/84597)

The Ukrainian Air Force reported Russia used 160 drones on the night of October 10, 110 of which were attack drones, marking a significant escalation in aerial bombardment intensity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure from October 7-10 forced emergency shutdowns in Kyiv and the region, disrupting metro, ground electric transport, and water supply; Ukrenergo introduced consumption schedules for industry and population by evening of October 10. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Ukraine is negotiating with European partners for additional rolling stock as the Financial Times reported the locomotive reserve is nearly exhausted, creating a bottleneck for export logistics and the economy. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

A Ukrainian delegation was in Miami for negotiations when the US announced eased restrictions on Russian diesel exports, which Zelensky called 'weak and unfair' and claimed the delegation was 'effectively used as a cover.' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Russia launched a massive combined drone and missile attack overnight October 10-11, employing approximately 160 drones (110 attack drones) plus Geran-5 rockets from multiple launch areas including Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Bryansk regions toward Kyiv, Rivne, Volyn, Dnipropetrovsk, Cherkasy, and Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76666, @mon1tor_ua/76664, @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed control of Annopol and Nova Kazachya in Kharkiv oblast, Kiyanitsa in Sumy oblast, and Samoylovka and Golubkovo in Zaporizhzhia oblast during October 3-9. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Russian forces continue offensive operations in the Orekhovsky direction and eastern Zaporizhzhia region, maintain pressure on the Dobrovolsky front, and conduct active fighting in Volchansk and Velikoburluk areas of Kharkiv oblast. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
The Russian MoD accused Ukrainian forces of hunting civilians in Konstantinovka (DPR) and hindering their evacuation, releasing video footage of the alleged actions. (Source: @tass_agency/399824)
Russian strikes targeted Yandex data centers in Sasovo (Ryazan region) and Kaluga region on October 8-9, causing equipment damage and service disruptions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Hungarian Prime Minister Orban refused military support to Ukraine and ruled out weapons transit through Hungarian territory, stating this position in an interview with Helsingin Sanomat. (Source: @tass_agency/399823)
Pro-Russian underground sources claimed at least 18,000 Ukrainians suffered from Territorial Recruitment Center (TCC) actions in 2026, per TASS reporting. (Source: @tass_agency/399829)

On the Kharkiv front, Russian offensive activity continues in the Volchansk and Velikoburluk areas, with the Russian MoD claiming capture of Annopol and Nova Kazachya during October 3-9. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

In the Krasnolimansk (Kramatorsk) direction, the situation remains difficult with Ukrainian counterattacks complicating Russian plans to develop an offensive on the northern flank of the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
On the Dobrovolsky (Avdiivka) front, Russian troops continue pressure but Ukrainian units retain counterattack capability, with heavy fighting ongoing. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Russian Armed Forces continue offensive operations in the Orekhovsky direction and eastern Zaporizhzhia region, claiming capture of Samoylovka and Golubkovo during the reporting period. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

On the Kherson front, Ukrainian forces control the bank with drone strikes and have not abandoned plans to use manpower on the Russian-held side, per Russian MoD assessment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
Russian forces claimed capture of Kiyanitsa in Sumy oblast during October 3-9, indicating northward expansion of controlled territory. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

The cumulative effect of Russian strikes on 750 kV substations is degrading energy transmission from Ukrainian nuclear power plants to consumers, compounding logistics strains from locomotive shortages. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Multiple jet Shaheds and Geran-5 rockets launched from Chernihiv oblast targeted Kyiv oblast's Vyshhorod and Brovary districts, with 7-9 Geran-5s and several Shaheds tracked on this vector overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76666, @mon1tor_ua/76664)

A jet Shahed from Bryansk region flew toward northern Chernihiv oblast, while reactive UAVs were detected south of Chernihiv moving southwest toward Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76635, @kpszsu/85432)

Jet UAVs from northern Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions flew westward toward Rivne oblast, with specific tracks toward Sarny district and Rokytne area. (Source: @kpszsu/85429, @kpszsu/85434, @eRadarrua/122182)
A Geran-5 rocket was reported over Rivne city, and three Geran-5s from Chernihiv targeted Kyiv's Vyshhorod district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76662, @mon1tor_ua/76666)
Reconnaissance UAVs detected a new UAV type in northern Chernihiv oblast near Olshivka heading toward the reservoir. (Source: @eRadarrua/122167, @eRadarrua/122162)
Air alert declared in Kyiv at 06:57 on October 12, 2026 due to drone threat (yellow level). (Source: @eRadarrua/122192)
Monitoring channels reported a jet Shahed falling on Kyiv's Nivky, Akadem, and Berkovets districts, and another on the Lavina shopping mall. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76630, @mon1tor_ua/76631)
Two jet Shaheds from Kherson oblast flew toward the Black Sea aquatory, indicating continued maritime drone activity. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76666)
Two jet Shaheds tracked on or near Kryvyi Rih in Dnipropetrovsk oblast, with additional UAVs detected near Krynytska and Solone in the same region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76666, @eRadarrua/122182)
A jet Shahed from occupied Zaporizhzhia flew toward occupied Kherson territory, showing internal rear-area drone movements. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76660)
A jet Shahed from Dnipropetrovsk oblast headed toward Kirovohrad oblast's Oleksandriia district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76664)
A jet Shahed on the border of Odesa and Mykolaiv oblasts was coursing toward Vinnytsia oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76635)
Two jet Shaheds reported on Dnipro and Kamianetske in Dnipropetrovsk oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76660)
Russian forces maintain drone control over the Kherson front bank and continue offensive operations in eastern Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)
Overnight October 10-11, Russia launched approximately 160 drones, 110 of which were attack drones, per Ukrainian Air Force data cited in intelligence summaries. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33883)

Geran-5 rockets appeared in significant numbers alongside Shaheds, with 7-9 launched from Chernihiv toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod, Brovary), 3 toward Rivne (Sarny), 1 toward Volyn (Kamin-Kashyrskyi), and 2 toward Ivano-Frankivsk via Ternopil. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76666, @mon1tor_ua/76652, @mon1tor_ua/76662)

Jet Shaheds (reactive UAVs) were tracked on multiple vectors: from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Boryspil, Vyshhorod), from Bryansk to northern Chernihiv, from Zhytomyr to Rivne (Sarny), from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Khmelnytskyi city and Kamianets-Podilskyi), from Poltava to Cherkasy (Zolotonosha), from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia), and from occupied territories. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76635, @mon1tor_ua/76666, @mon1tor_ua/76660, @mon1tor_ua/76664)
Kyiv air defense engaged targets over Nivky, Akadem, Berkovets districts and the Lavina mall, with monitoring channels confirming impacts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76630, @mon1tor_ua/76631)
Air alert activated in Kyiv at 06:57 on October 12, 2026 (yellow level) due to drone threat. (Source: @eRadarrua/122192)
Reactive UAVs detected near Reshetylivka (Poltava) and Nova Vodolaha (Kharkiv), and a Geran-5 over Rivne city. (Source: @eRadarrua/122169, @mon1tor_ua/76662)
Jet UAVs reported on Kyiv from both north and south, and on Rivne from north of Zhytomyr, indicating multi-axis approach patterns. (Source: @kpszsu/85455, @kpszsu/85442)
